A '''microscope''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] device. [[Varel DeVay]], a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' used a hand microscope to assist her in her work.
